description: The local inference server for coding agents. Pure Rust, one binary, Apple Silicon + NVIDIA. Anthropic + OpenAI APIs; the KV cache survives across turns, so turn 20 starts as fast as turn 2. OPD training on the same runtime.
summary: Pure-Rust LLM runtime: one binary serves (OpenAI-compatible), runs local agents, and distills models on their own rollouts — on Apple Silicon and NVIDIA. No Python on the hot path.
